Zwicker (Zwickern) is a North German fishing game from Schleswig-Holstein, related to Casino and Scopa. First recorded in print in 1930 in Robert Hülsemann's Das Buch der Spiele; originally played with a 52-card pack, now commonly with 3, 4, or 6 jokers. Popular in Dithmarschen, North Frisia, and Eiderstedt; 58-card Zwicker packs were sold from the 1950s by ASS and Nürnberger Spielkarten.
52 cards + 0-6 Jokers. K=14, Q=13, J=12, A=11 or 1.
